item.title: THRILLING FINAL ROUND OF 4 DAY SERIES ACTION BRINGS DOWN THE CURTAIN
item.description: The final round of the 4 Day Series was as enthralling as it could possibly get with a number of teams in the running for a spot in the final. The post THRILLING FINAL ROUND OF 4 DAY SERIES ACTION BRINGS DOWN THE CURTAIN first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: LIONS AND WARRIORS SET FOR RED-BALL SHOWDOWN IN 4 DAY SERIES FINAL AT THE WANDERERS
item.description: The stage is set for a traditional red-ball contest as the DP World Lions host the Dafabet Warriors in the 4 Day Series final, starting on Wednesday at the DP World Wanderers Stadium. The post LIONS AND WARRIORS SET FOR RED-BALL SHOWDOWN IN 4 DAY SERIES FINAL AT THE WANDERERS first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: KING AND HERMANN CENTURIES LEVEL DAY AGAINST THE LIONS
item.description: Centuries from Jordan Hermann and young JP King helped the Dafabet Warriors finish day one of the 4 Day Series final on an even keel with the DP World Lions at the DP World Wanderers on Wednesday. The post KING AND HERMANN CENTURIES LEVEL DAY AGAINST THE LIONS first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: KAPP RULED OUT OF PAKISTAN ODI SERIES; UNCAPPED COWLING NAMED AS REPLACEMENT
item.description: Proteas Women all-rounder Marizanne Kapp has been ruled out of the upcoming ICC Women’s Championship One-Day International series against Pakistan, scheduled from 22 February - 01 March, due to illness. The post KAPP RULED OUT OF PAKISTAN ODI SERIES; UNCAPPED COWLING NAMED AS REPLACEMENT first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: BOAST BOWLS WARRIORS INTO POUND SEATS ON DAY TWO
item.description: Dafabet Warriors seamer Matthew Boast took 5 for 35 to help his team into a position of strength on day two of the 4 Day Series final against the DP World Lions at the DP World Wanderers on Thursday. The post BOAST BOWLS WARRIORS INTO POUND SEATS ON DAY TWO first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: PROTEAS MEN’S SQUAD ANNOUNCED FOR NEW ZEALAND T20I SERIES
item.description: The South African Men’s selection panel has announced the 15-player squad for the outbound five-match T20 International (T20I) series against New Zealand from 15 - 25 March. The post PROTEAS MEN’S SQUAD ANNOUNCED FOR NEW ZEALAND T20I SERIES first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: YUSUF HELPS LIONS TO MEMORABLE 4 DAY TITLE
item.description: In a match that has ebbed and flowed, the DP World Lions seamers Codi Yusuf and Beyers Swanepoel bowled them to an eight wicket win over the Dafabet Warriors at the DP World Wanderers on Friday to claim the 4 Day Series title for a third consecutive time. The post YUSUF HELPS LIONS TO MEMORABLE 4 DAY TITLE first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: PROTEAS WOMEN TO BE BRAVE WHEN IT COUNTS AHEAD IWC ODI SERIES AGAINST PAKISTAN
item.description: Proteas Women captain Laura Wolvaardt has emphasised the importance of a strong start as South Africa begin their ICC Women’s Championship (IWC) campaign with a three-match One-Day International (ODI) series against Pakistan, starting in Bloemfontein on Sunday. The post PROTEAS WOMEN TO BE BRAVE WHEN IT COUNTS AHEAD IWC ODI SERIES AGAINST PAKISTAN first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: DRAGONS AND PROVINCE SECURE CRUCIAL VICTORIES
item.description: The latest round of Hollywoodbets Pro50 fixtures in the Hollywoodbets Pro Series delivered contrasting outcomes across the country, with clinical chases in Potchefstroom and Cape Town, while weather intervened in Pretoria to halt proceedings. item.title: TITANS, LIONS AND DRAGONS PREVAIL TO CLAIM HOLLYWOODBETS PRO20 VICTORIES
item.description: It was a decisive day of Hollywoodbets Pro20 action in the Hollywoodbets Pro Series, as dominant performances from the Fidelity Titans Ladies, DP World Lions Women and North West Dragons Women set the tone in a round marked by commanding wins.
